title: End of Egypt's 17th Dynasty and start of the 18th
summary: CFAH triangulates the end of Dynasty 17 and the start of Dynasty 18 of Egypt, including a count from the Exodus.
description: CFAH triangulates the end of Dynasty 17 and the start of Dynasty 18 of Egypt, including a count from the Exodus. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 1081 BC (AP-63, OSF preprint CFAH-8)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-8: Placing Dynasties 15-18," OSF preprint v1.2 (29 Apr 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/Z5RTD, file CFAH-8_v1.2.pdf, p. 18 ("new Anchor Point #63, the End of Dynasty 17, and Start of Dynasty 18 in 1081 BC")
